rows.text: When your battery usage is higher than usual,
iPhone can extend your battery life by making
performance adjustments, such as lowering display
brightness, allowing some activities to take longer,
or turning on Low Power Mode at 20%.
iPhone will temporarily reduce some background
activities, processing speed, display refresh rate
and brightness, and limit certain features such as
5G, iCloud syncing, mail fetch, and more.
